scope: Read-only authority audit for residual binding and direct MIR; no implementation or execution acceptance.

facts.authority: codes! defines native Code ordering, CODE_NAMES and code_by_name. Compiler operand-catalog ordering is not native tag identity.
Native handler dispatch entries resolve code_by_name from the existing catalog.
verify_classes bounds integer operands against verified Function.nireg.
Binary register verifier bounds integer operands against graph registers[1], subsequently carried to Function.nireg.
encode_function encodes executable instructions followed by packed jump tables. Storage byte length is not executable ncode and has no general extra terminal sentinel.
Hotpatch replaces the same function ID and retains old Function allocations only for live frames. Function ID and image digest alone do not retain an original body.

existingNuppApi: vm.loadImage returns a function value; vm.imageIdentity/imageModules expose identity metadata. None supplies authenticated retained body ownership plus verified tag association and integer extent.
nextGate: Reuse verified Function and native encoder/catalog through a narrow host-issued capability, or complete authoritative Nupp loader prerequisite; do not introduce another decoder or opcode map.
Private adapter chooses canonical templates and calls prepare/bind; reject caller-supplied tags, counts, graphs and copied verified records as authority.
Pin executable body allocation/version across hotpatch; define installation invalidation and release lifecycle.
Use executable ncode separately from storage extent, and validate next dispatch PC is an executable instruction.
limits: Private canonical residual snapshots authenticate provenance inside the isolated compiler prototype; retained copied bytes do not authenticate original VM PCs. This audit does not add loader authority, production JIT routing or E0 acceptance.
